name: Begur (Spain)
description: Quartered in cross, the hoist quarters white with the black castle of the arms above blue separated by a wavy line, the fly quarters red above and yellow below.
history: The flag, based on the arms (approved 3 September 1993), was approved on 6 September 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided in cross into four parts, the two at the hoist square and separated by a wavy line of two waves, the upper white charged with the black castle of the arms.

features.role: castle of the arms in the upper hoist quarter, 1/3 of the height
lower hoist quarter with a wavy division
